pairs: Then calling together the twelve Apostles,
dedit illis virtutem et potestatem super omnia dæmonia, et ut languores curarent.
he gave them power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases.
Et misit illos prædicare regnum Dei,
And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God
“You should take nothing for the journey,
and you should not have two tunics.
And into whatever house you shall enter,
and do not move away from there.
And whoever will not have received you,
etiam pulverem pedum vestrorum excutite in testimonium supra illos.
shake off even the dust on your feet, as a testimony against them.”
Egressi autem circuibant per castella evangelizantes,
And going forth, they traveled around, through the towns,
Audivit autem Herodes tetrarcha omnia quæ fiebant ab eo,
Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all the things that were being done by him,
but he doubted, because it was said
a quibusdam: Quia Joannes surrexit a mortuis:
by some, “For John has risen from the dead,”
Quia propheta unus de antiquis surrexit.
“For one of the prophets from of old has risen again.”
quis est autem iste, de quo ego talia audio?
who is this, about whom I hear such things?”
And he sought to see him.
they explained to him all the things that they had done.
et assumptis illis secessit seorsum in locum desertum,
And taking them with him, he withdrew to a deserted place apart,
But when the crowd had realized this,
et excepit eos, et loquebatur illis de regno Dei,
And he received them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God.
And those who were in need of cures,
Then the day began to decline.
And drawing near, the twelve said to him:
ut euntes in castella villasque quæ circa sunt,
so that, by going into the surrounding towns and villages,
they may separate and find food.
quia hic in loco deserto sumus.
For we are here in a deserted place.”
Vos date illis manducare. At illi dixerunt:
“You give them something to eat.” And they said,
Non sunt nobis plus quam quinque panes et duo pisces:
“There is with us no more than five loaves and two fish,
nisi forte nos eamus, et emamus in omnem hanc turbam escas.
unless perhaps we are to go and buy food for this entire multitude.”
Erant autem fere viri quinque millia.
Now there were about five thousand men.
So he said to his disciples,
Facite illos discumbere per convivia quinquagenos.
“Have them recline to eat in groups of fifty.”
And they caused them all to recline to eat.
Acceptis autem quinque panibus et duobus piscibus,
Then, taking the five loaves and the two fish,
et benedixit illis: et fregit, et distribuit discipulis suis,
and he blessed and broke and distributed them to his disciples,
in order to set them before the crowd.
Et sublatum est quod superfuit illis,
And twelve baskets of fragments were taken up,
which were left over from them.
Et factum est cum solus esset orans,
his disciples also were with him,
“Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
alii vero quia unus propheta de prioribus surrexit.
others say that one of the prophets from before has risen again.”
Vos autem quem me esse dicitis?
“But who do you say that I am?”
he instructed them not to tell this to anyone,
Quia oportet Filium hominis multa pati,
“For the Son of man must suffer many things,
and be rejected by the elders
and the leaders of the priests
and on the third day rise again.”
Si quis vult post me venire,
“If anyone is willing to come after me:
and take up his cross every day,
Qui enim voluerit animam suam salvam facere,
For whoever will have saved his life,
nam qui perdiderit animam suam propter me,
Yet whoever will have lost his life for my sake,
For how does it benefit a man,
if he were to gain the whole world,
Nam qui me erubuerit, et meos sermones: hunc Filius hominis erubescet cum venerit in majestate sua, et Patris, et sanctorum angelorum.
For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words: of him the Son of man will be ashamed, when he will have arrived in his majesty and that of his Father and of the holy Angels.
And yet, I tell you a truth:
sunt aliqui hic stantes, qui non gustabunt mortem donec videant regnum Dei.
There are some standing here who shall not taste death, until they see the kingdom of God.”
Factum est autem post hæc verba fere dies octo,
about eight days after these words,
he took Peter and James and John,
and he ascended onto a mountain,
et ascendit in montem ut oraret.
the appearance of his countenance was altered,
et vestitus ejus albus et refulgens.
Et ecce duo viri loquebantur cum illo.
And behold, two men were talking with him.
And these were Moses and Elijah, appearing in majesty.
visi in majestate: et dicebant excessum ejus,
And they spoke of his departure,
which he would accomplish at Jerusalem.
et qui cum illo erant, gravati erant somno.
Peter and those who were with him were weighed down by sleep.
Et evigilantes viderunt majestatem ejus, et duos viros qui stabant cum illo.
And becoming alert, they saw his majesty and the two men who were standing with him.
Et factum est cum discederent ab illo,
And it happened that, as these were departing from him,
it is good for us to be here.
And so, let us make three tabernacles:
For he did not know what he was saying.
as he was saying these things,
a cloud came and overshadowed them.
And as these were entering into the cloud,
Et vox facta est de nube,
And a voice came from the cloud,
Et dum fieret vox, inventus est Jesus solus. Et ipsi tacuerunt, et nemini dixerunt in illis diebus quidquam ex his quæ viderant.
And while the voice was being uttered, Jesus was found to be alone. And they were silent and told no one, in those days, any of these things, which they had seen.
Factum est autem in sequenti die,
But it happened on the following day that,
as they were descending from the mountain,
Et ecce vir de turba exclamavit,
And behold, a man from the crowd cried out,
respice in filium meum quia unicus est mihi:
look kindly on my son, for he is my only son.
And behold, a spirit takes hold of him,
et elidit, et dissipat eum cum spuma,
and it throws him down and convulses him, so that he foams.
And though it tears him apart, it leaves him only with difficulty.
et rogavi discipulos tuos ut ejicerent illum,
And I asked your disciples to cast him out,
How long will I be with you
And as he was approaching him,
And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit,
and he restored him to his father.
Stupebant autem omnes in magnitudine Dei:
And all were astonished at the greatness of God.
omnibusque mirantibus in omnibus quæ faciebat,
And as everyone was wondering over all that he was doing,
Ponite vos in cordibus vestris sermones istos:
“You must set these words in your hearts.
Filius enim hominis futurum est ut tradatur in manus hominum.
For it shall be that the Son of man will be delivered into the hands of men.”
But they did not understand this word,
et erat velatum ante eos ut non sentirent illud:
and it was concealed from them, so that they did not perceive it.
et timebant eum interrogare de hoc verbo.
And they were afraid to question him about this word.
Intravit autem cogitatio in eos quis eorum major esset.
Now an idea entered into them, as to which of them was greater.
At Jesus videns cogitationes cordis illorum,
perceiving the thoughts of their hearts,
took a child and stood him beside him.
Quicumque susceperit puerum istum in nomine meo,
“Whoever will receive this child in my name,
Nam qui minor est inter vos omnes,
For whoever is the lesser among you all,
vidimus quemdam in nomine tuo ejicientem dæmonia,
we saw a certain one casting out demons in your name.
for he does not follow with us.”
qui enim non est adversum vos,
For whoever is not against you,
Factum est autem dum complerentur dies assumptionis ejus,
Now it happened that, while the days of his dissipation were being completed,
et ipse faciem suam firmavit ut iret in Jerusalem.
he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem.
Et misit nuntios ante conspectum suum:
And he sent messengers before his face.
et euntes intraverunt in civitatem Samaritanorum ut parerent illi.
And going on, they entered into a city of the Samaritans, to prepare for him.
And they would not receive him,
quia facies ejus erat euntis in Jerusalem.
because his face was going toward Jerusalem.
Cum vidissent autem discipuli ejus Jacobus
vis dicimus ut ignis descendat de cælo,
do you want us to call for fire to descend from heaven and consume them?”
And turning, he rebuked them, saying:
“Do you not know of whose spirit you are?
Filius hominis non venit animas perdere,
The Son of man came, not to destroy lives,
And they went into another town.
as they were walking along the way,
“I will follow you, wherever you will go.”
and the birds of the air have nests.
Filius autem hominis non habet ubi caput reclinet.
But the Son of man has nowhere to lay his head.”
Sine ut mortui sepeliant mortuos suos:
and announce the kingdom of God.”
sed permitte mihi primum renuntiare his quæ domi sunt.
Lord. But permit me first to explain this to those of my house.”
Nemo mittens manum suam ad aratrum,
“No one who puts his hand to the plow,
is fit for the kingdom of God.”
